vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-34040
vulnerability.description: Moby authorization-plugin bypass when processing oversized request bodies

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerability is in Docker daemon authorization-plugin request handling. The k3d client executable does not link Docker daemon packages; the package build fails if a github.com/docker/docker/daemon dependency appears.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-15558
vulnerability.description: Docker CLI plugin manager uncontrolled search path on Windows

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable cli-plugins/manager package is not linked into k3d. The package build verifies the complete Go dependency list and fails if that package appears.
